newsitem.title: NEPAL: Chinese president to visit Nepal next week.
newsitem.headline: Chinese president to visit Nepal next week.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin will arrive in Nepal on December 4 on a two-day state visit, a Foreign Ministry statement said on Saturday.
It said Jiang, the first president of neighbouring China to visit Nepal in 12 years, will be the guest of Nepal's King Birendra.
Jiang was scheduled to leave Kathmandu for Beijing on December 5, it added. He is currently on a visit to India and will travel to Pakistan on Sunday.
